graph_hero_questions.text: Which facilities exhibit the highest compliance risk based on historical RCRA violations, enforcement actions, and total penalty amounts?
What is the total volume of hazardous waste generated across different NAICS industry codes and EPA regions?
Which Treatment, Storage, and Disposal Facilities (TSDFs) receive the highest volumes of acute hazardous waste within specific geographic areas?
Can we trace the complete chain of custody for specific waste shipments from the generating facility through all intermediate transporters to the final destination?
Which sites are nearing their LQG threshold this quarter?
What drove the maintenance cost spike per unit last quarter — work orders, contract escalations, or outage-driven repairs?
Which assets failed more than once in the last twelve months, and did the repair hold?
What can be completed inside the next outage window without extending it?
Which vendors escalated rates above the contracted baseline, and what did that cost us?
Where is spend most likely to surprise us before quarter close?
Which incidents share a root cause that has not been closed out?
Which process change moved the defect rate, and on which lines?
Which generators shipping to Deer Park are under active RCRA enforcement, and how much waste did we accept from them?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: The core liability question — connects inbound manifests to generator compliance records.

graph_hero_questions.text: Trace manifest [MTN] cradle-to-grave: who generated it, who hauled it, when did we receive it, and how long was it in transit?
Show every generator with an open (unreturned-to-compliance) RCRA violation that shipped to us in the last 12 months.
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Surfaces active regulatory exposure in the inbound stream.

graph_hero_questions.text: What does the Chemours consent decree say, and are we accepting waste from that facility?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Bridges unstructured enforcement documents to the live manifest stream — the graph payoff.

graph_hero_questions.text: Summarize our own facility’s compliance standing: evaluations, violations, penalties.
graph_hero_questions.rationale: The operator's own view self-view; the clean-record anchor.

graph_hero_questions.text: Which of our inbound generators are named in a federal consent decree or CAFO, and what is our tonnage exposure to them?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Extends the graph payoff across the whole document set, not just Chemours.

graph_hero_questions.text: Rank every generator shipping to Deer Park by total RCRA penalty exposure.
graph_hero_questions.rationale: The prioritized liability leaderboard a compliance manager screens against.

graph_hero_questions.text: How has our inbound hazardous-waste volume trended by quarter, and is any generator ramping up shipments to us?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Operations trend view; ties volume to specific generators over time.

graph_hero_questions.text: Which transporters carry the most loads into Deer Park, and does any hauler in our custody chain have its own enforcement history?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Custody-chain risk — surfaces the Stericycle document link on the transporter side.

graph_hero_questions.text: What waste codes dominate our inbound stream, and which generators send the most Land-Disposal-Restricted (LDR) waste?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Waste-profile view; connects waste codes to generators and LDR compliance.

graph_hero_questions.text: What share of our inbound tonnage in the last 12 months came from generators carrying an open violation?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Single-number exposure headline for the boardroom.

graph_hero_questions.text: Show me every rejected load and residue manifest, and which generators they came from.
Is ‘Texas Molecular’ the same facility as ‘Texas Molecular LP’ — how does the system know?
graph_hero_questions.rationale: Entity-resolution proof; the trust moment for the CIO.

graph_use_case_templates.name: Cradle-to-Grave Compliance & Liability Intelligence
graph_use_case_templates.description: Cradle-to-grave intelligence over the inbound manifest stream, each generator’s and transporter’s federal compliance record, and public enforcement documents — unified into one queryable model, so the receiving facility can see the liability it takes on before it accepts the next load.
match_phrases: before it accepts the next load

graph_metrics.name: Maintenance cost per unit
graph_metrics.definition: Total maintenance spend over the period, divided by units in service.

graph_metrics.name: Unplanned outage hours
graph_metrics.definition: Hours lost to outages that were not in the maintenance plan.

graph_metrics.name: Mean time between failures
graph_metrics.definition: Average operating hours between two failures of the same asset.

graph_metrics.name: Work order backlog age
graph_metrics.definition: Median age of open work orders, weighted by priority.

graph_metrics.name: Contract escalation rate
graph_metrics.definition: Period-on-period change in contracted rates against the baseline.

graph_metrics.name: Budget variance at quarter close
graph_metrics.definition: Actual versus planned spend at close, split by the driver behind it.

graph_metrics.name: Manifest cycle time
graph_metrics.definition: Days from generator pickup to confirmed disposal certificate.

graph_metrics.name: Compliance exception rate
graph_metrics.definition: Share of shipments raising at least one compliance exception.

graph_metrics.name: Incident closure rate
graph_metrics.definition: Share of incidents with corrective actions closed inside target.

graph_metrics.name: First pass yield
graph_metrics.definition: Units passing every step without rework, over units started.

graph_metrics.name: Scrap rate
graph_metrics.definition: Material scrapped as a share of material consumed.

graph_metrics.name: Data freshness lag
graph_metrics.definition: Age of the newest record backing an answer, at the time it is given.

graph_metrics.name: Inbound hazardous waste accepted
graph_metrics.definition: Measured in tons, from e_manifest rollup.

graph_metrics.name: Inbound manifests processed
graph_metrics.definition: Measured in manifests, from e_manifest row count.

graph_metrics.name: Distinct generators shipping to Deer Park
Rejected inbound loads
graph_metrics.definition: Measured in manifests, from e_manifest REJECTION=Y.

graph_metrics.name: Residue manifests
graph_metrics.definition: Measured in manifests, from e_manifest MANIFEST RESIDUE=Y.

graph_metrics.name: Texas Molecular own penalties
graph_metrics.definition: Measured in USD, from RCRA_Compliance_Summary (the operator).

graph_answer_formats.format: narrative + exposure table + implicated facility list
